This page presents the key clinical endpoint results from the SCLC-01 analysis.

::: {.callout-note}
## Data Cutoff
Results on this page are based on **DCO3 (January 2026)**. For comparisons across data cutoffs, see [DCO Comparisons](../comparisons/dco-comparisons.qmd).
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## Related Pages
- See [Model Specification](../documentation/model-specification.qmd#sec-clinical-endpoints) for endpoint definitions
- See [Survival Analysis](survival-analysis.qmd) for Kaplan-Meier curves
:::

## Overall Response Rate (ORR) {#sec-orr}

Overall response rate represents the proportion of patients achieving complete response (CR) or partial response (PR), confirmed at two consecutive visits.

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Sample-Based

```{r}
#| label: fig-orr-sample
#| fig-cap: Sample-based overall response rate (ORR), split by PDL1 status and treatment line for the SCLC-01 trial.

plot_orr_by_estimate_type("sample", jan26_orr_data, jan26_cond_orr_data)
```

### Superpopulation

```{r}
#| label: fig-orr-spop
#| fig-cap: Superpopulation overall response rate (ORR), split by PDL1 status and treatment line for the SCLC-01 trial.

plot_orr_by_estimate_type("spop", jan26_orr_data, jan26_cond_orr_data)
```

:::

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Sample-Based

#### All Patients

```{r}
#| label: tbl-orr-summary-sample-all
#| tbl-cap: "Sample-based ORR summary for all patients."

create_orr_table("sample", "all", jan26_orr_data, jan26_cond_orr_data)
```

#### First Line Patients

```{r}
#| label: tbl-orr-summary-sample-first-line
#| tbl-cap: "Sample-based ORR summary for first line patients."

create_orr_table("sample", "first_line", jan26_orr_data, jan26_cond_orr_data)
```

#### Part E

```{r}
#| label: tbl-orr-summary-sample-part-e
#| tbl-cap: "Sample-based ORR summary for Part E patients."

```

## Median Progression-Free Survival {#sec-median-pfs}

Median PFS represents the time at which 50% of patients have experienced progression or death.

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Sample-Based

```{r}
#| label: fig-median-pfs-sample
#| fig-cap: Sample-based median progression-free survival (PFS), split by PDL1 status and treatment line for the SCLC-01 trial.

plot_median_pfs_by_estimate_type("sample", jan26_quant_pfs_data, jan26_cond_quant_pfs_data)
```

### Superpopulation

```{r}
#| label: fig-median-pfs-spop
#| fig-cap: Superpopulation median progression-free survival (PFS), split by PDL1 status and treatment line for the SCLC-01 trial.
```

## PFS at Fixed Timepoints (PFS-n) {#sec-pfs-n}

PFS-n represents the probability of being progression-free at specific timepoints (e.g., 6, 9, 12, 18 months).

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Sample-Based

```{r}
#| label: fig-pfs-n-sample
#| fig-cap: Sample-based progression-free survival (PFS) at different time points, split by PDL1 status and treatment line for the SCLC-01 trial.

plot_pfs_n_by_estimate_type("sample", jan26_pfs_n_data, jan26_cond_pfs_n_data, pfs_timepoints)
```

### Superpopulation

```{r}
#| label: fig-pfs-n-spop
#| fig-cap: Superpopulation progression-free survival (PFS) at different time points, split by PDL1 status and treatment line for the SCLC-01 trial.

plot_pfs_n_by_estimate_type("spop", jan26_pfs_n_data, jan26_cond_pfs_n_data, pfs_timepoints)
```

:::

::: {.panel-tabset}
